title: Coach Kyle's Extreme Training Program
author: Kyle R.
desc:
This is a high intensity program designed to maximize gains whether bulking, cutting, or maintaining. Each session should be around 2 hours in length. 

The end result? Being a sickunt. Do you want to mog them all? Then try this. 

This is my personal weekly workout regimen that I use. I went from being a 150lbs skinnykunt to a 180lbs sickunt in less than 6 months on this program with NO SUPPLEMENTS. Not even creatine. I have been a ISSA Certified CPT for 3 years and this program here really changed the game for me. It is designed to push you to, and beyond, your limits. 

If you would like further training/diet plan you can email me at krohrabaugh1@gmail.com for personal training options starting at 100 dollars a session.

ex.note:
1st set: 1/4 max, 15-20 reps
2nd set: 1/2 max, 10-15 reps
3rd set: 2/3 max, 8-10 reps
4th set: max weight to failure
